checks.name: A2 <rhat> = 0 (the identity every orthogonality result rests on)
B1 enclosed baryons (incl. OFF-CENTRE) contribute ZERO to the sphere mean
checks.why: every exterior-multipole term of an interior source carries l >= 1 angular dependence (or is radial ~ rhat), and <Y_lm> = <rhat> = 0 -- so the mean vanishes for ANY interior configuration, centred or not

checks.name: B2 environment: <g_env> = g_env(B) (the mean-value property)
checks.why: each Cartesian component of the exterior field is harmonic inside the ball, so its sphere average equals its centre value -- exactly

checks.name: C1 UNIFORM environment: eta absorbs it, Gamma INVARIANT
checks.why: a uniform field has zero fluctuation -> it cannot move Gamma; this is the orthogonality the lane has used since SW01b, now the (T1)-(T3) corollary

checks.name: C2 TIDAL environment (g_env(B) = 0): eta stays EXACTLY 0, Gamma moves
checks.detail: |g_env(B)| = 0.00e+00 -> eta = 4.30e-16 (S = 1, no suppression); Gamma 1.718313 vs isolated 1.688594 (ratio 1.0176)
checks.why: the symmetric external pair cancels at the centre (pure AC) -> it cannot reach eta at all but adds structure to Gamma: UNIFORM SUPPRESSES (amplitude, conformal); TIDAL DISTORTS (shape, S = 1). This is the DC/AC split, P10

checks.name: C3 consequence: the tidal channel changes the boost with S pinned at 1
checks.why: shape distortion with no suppression -- NOT conformal, unlike the uniform channel (SW04 B1: Q(R) = S*Q_iso(R) exactly, 2.22e-16)

checks.name: D1[HINGE] (T1) localises at the CENTRE B
checks.detail: |<g_N> - g_env(B)| / |g_env(B)|: 6.93e-15 (centre) vs 1.85e+00 (field point P); the tidal variation across the sphere is 1.85e+00
checks.why: the ambient value that enters eta is the field at the BARYCENTRE, not at the field point; the two differ by the environment's tidal variation

checks.name: D2 (T2) retro-justifies the record's calibration: eta_sun = |g_env(B)|/a0
checks.why: v_c^2/R_0 IS the ambient Galactic field at the Solar radius, so SW01b's eta_sun is exactly |g_env(B)|/a0 -- right for a deeper reason than the lane knew
